title: Save Money
supportedClaims: Saving is powerful because it creates flexibility before it creates a specific purchase or forecast.
A savings buffer widens your options, lowers desperation, and gives you time to respond when life changes faster than your plans.
The reader is pushed to reduce the gap between ego and expenses, keep a margin, and treat cash reserves as future choice rather than dead weight.
caution: Saving without purpose can feel abstract, so the chapter has to remind the reader that optionality itself is a purpose.
